procedure: 记录根域、土壤压实、含水、树池连通、成活和维护工单，区分数量与功能。
Record raw observations, missing data and reviewer sign-off.
Update status only after the required evidence exists.
pass_rule: 每个树池单元有根域、维护频率、故障触发和补植规则。
stop_rule: 没有土壤、管线或维护证据时不把种植数量写成生态绩效。
non_ai_equivalent: 人工养护、土壤检查和补植
boundary_note: This is a review and implementation gate, not evidence that the current provisional design has passed it or that the proposed operator has been appointed.
